finding_2.title: The Content Performance Curve (p.7)
finding_2.outcome: FlyRank health score = 30 impressions + 30 position + 20 CTR + 20 scroll
finding_2.question: cross-section of different pages, not a within-page lifecycle; 365+ bucket is a survivor sample

finding_4.title: The Freshness Multiplier (p.9)
finding_4.outcome: current health score and impressions, treatment = refreshed within 30 days
finding_4.question: no matched control for selection into refresh; 30-day treatment window overlaps the 30-day measurement window

limitations: the frame is 57% of March pages (>=100 impressions); the long tail is out of scope
nine clients per held-out draw, so the mean across five seeds is the headline, not one draw
the label compares April with all of March, so within-March momentum is partly mechanical
the population is one month pair; nothing here is causal or repeats over time
